title.zh: 社会组织中规则差异的形成与继承
title.en: Formation and inheritance of organizational rule differences

claim.zh: 对每个过程、动作上的门与构型的量：量沿每段非门控进程保持，当且仅当每个非门控步保持它；改变它的进程经过门，且在一个本身改变它的门控步上。组织程序中只有采纳对规则是门控的：其余每个事件保持规则，所以每段不采纳的历史继承规则，每次规则改变都位于一次采纳。共同工作与认可形成参与资格，实际提案经既有授权程序改变后续筛选规则；分化或交接携带该规则，实际继续参与决定其执行，继承的差异改变后续可进入的决策。
claim.en: For every process, gate on moves and quantity of configurations: the quantity is kept along every course of ungated moves exactly when every ungated step keeps it; a course that changes it passes the gate, at a gated step that itself changes it. In the organizational protocol only adoption is gated for the rule: every other event keeps it, so every nonadopting history inherits the rule and every rule change is located at an adoption. Reviewed work and recognition form mandates; an actual proposal changes the later filtering rule through the existing authorization procedure. Branching or handoff carries that rule, continuing participation determines execution, and inherited differences change subsequent admitted decisions.

hypotheses.zh: 种子授权、认可及复制能力、提案内容、参与和遵守程序给定；更高层修订程序固定。
hypotheses.en: Seed mandate, recognition/copying capacity, proposal content, participation and procedural compliance are supplied; the higher amendment procedure is fixed.

hypotheses.zh: 多数票以完整登记名册为分母；两人后备路径有十四天输入与无反对条件，不模拟真实时钟、共识或执行软件。
hypotheses.en: Majority uses the full recorded roster; the two-support fallback has a fourteen-day input and no-opposition condition. No real clock, consensus process or software execution is simulated.

hypotheses.zh: 实际工作的执行、能力变化及持续参与的形成未闭合；被接受的决策数量不是工作后果。
hypotheses.en: Work execution, capability change and the production of continued participation are not closed; admitted-decision counts are not work consequences.

correspondence.zh: 社会接续从共同工作、资格和规则记录中分化；分支可共享参与者，记录继承不独自生成实际参与。Valkey及TDF原始材料提供有限机制对应，不是模型全程的实证复现。 整体与子系统是同一活动中的分化；该程序只表示其中一段关系，未形式化完整的相互反馈及边界变化。 解释以活动结果进入后续辨认与修订的具体关系、时序和参与变化为准；修复与学习可在同一活动中形成，不能由正式培训减少直接推出能力下降。
correspondence.en: Social continuations differentiate through work, mandates and retained rule histories. Branches can share participants, and inherited records do not create participation. Primary Valkey/TDF records support bounded mechanism correspondence, not empirical reproduction of the whole model. Whole and subsystems differentiate within the same activity; this protocol represents one connection, not formalized complete reciprocal feedback or changing boundaries. Exposition identifies how activity results enter later interpretation and revision, with changing order and participation. Repair and learning may form in one activity; fewer formal training sessions do not directly imply reduced capability.

detail.zh: 接续固定规律之后的组织变异问题；不导入其模型或宣称形式跨域适配。
detail.en: Continues the organizing-variation question left by fixed-law reconstruction; does not import that model or claim a formal cross-domain adapter.

detail.zh: 后续成果正式复用本程序，生成其审查输入并形成进一步参与；原成果的证明不依赖后续扩展。
detail.en: The later result formally reuses this protocol, produces its review input and forms further participation; this original proof does not depend on the extension.

detail.zh: 复制规则而无人继续参与无法运作；仅两人时技术决策可执行而治理修订失败；重复投票、未到期限及反对保留失败。
detail.en: A copied rule without continuing participation cannot operate. Two participants may permit technical decisions while governance revision fails. Duplicate votes, inadequate time and opposition retain failure.

limitations.zh: 只证明条件性社会程序连接；未推出提案创造、最高授权起源、实际合法遵守、规则群体扩散优势或伦理正当性。 工作／能力／参与的反馈及子系统分化尚未接通；不能以程序链完成替代整体组织动力学完成。
limitations.en: Only a conditional institutional connection is proved; proposal creativity, origin of highest authority, actual procedural compliance, population propagation advantage and ethical warrant remain unproved. Work/capability/participation feedback and subsystem differentiation remain unconnected; procedural completion is not completion of whole organizational dynamics.

validation_scope.zh: 29项新定理／53项声明审计，81项实际导入闭包审计；原始记录审读与形式实查分开，无独立 agent 验收。
validation_scope.en: 29 new theorems / 53 declaration audits, 81 audits in the actual import closure. Primary-record reading and formal checking remain separate; no independent-agent acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 复用 joint-practice-forms-continuation 已接通的实际实践与后续参与；继续解释任务、检验关系及参与方式的变化，不重开原条件继承。
next_delta.en: Reuse the enacted-practice/further-participation connection in joint-practice-forms-continuation; investigate changing tasks, test relations and means of participation without reopening original conditional inheritance.

Built with scratch_build, empty axiom reports; the landing run binds the receipt. The original theorems, receipt and counterexamples are unchanged.
